title: Roadmap Unblocking Charter and Dependency Costing Matrix
creator: Priya Menon
description:
Goal: Create a lightweight, initiative-level charter and quantitative matrix that helps PMs, Eng, Design, Security, and Infra trade off roadmap sequencing by (a) expected unblock time, (b) cross-team effort, and (c) produced risk/cost. The output will be a one-page charter template, a dependency_costing_matrix spreadsheet with a scoring formula, an internal dashboard for upcoming cycle planners, and a published runbook for escalation and handoffs.

Why: Current dependency signals are noisy and binary (blocked/not-blocked). Teams need a common currency to prioritize which upstream work to accelerate, which to defer, and which to accept as long-lead items. This reduces delay windows on quarterly OKRs and gives Sales/Customer Success clearer expectations.

Scope: Initiative-level dependencies (not per-PR). Only cross-team dependencies that impact scheduled ship dates for roadmap initiatives this quarter. Excludes purely experimental spikes and one-off bugfixes unless they gate a release.

Approach: 1) Define a dependency_cost_score = (LeadTimeWeeks * TeamEffortMultiplier) + (RiskMultiplier * CustomerImpactTier) + EscalationPenalty. 2) Pilot scoring on top 30 flagged dependencies for Q1/Q2 initiatives. 3) Build simple spreadsheet and a follow-up lightweight dashboard slice in Console for PM/ENG triage. 4) Publish charter and runbook and run two cross-team workshops to socialize.

Outputs (deliverables):
- Charter template (one page) for initiative owners to submit dependency claims.
- dependency_costing_matrix (spreadsheet) with scoring and examples.
- Pilot report summarizing 30 scored dependencies and recommended sequencing changes.
- Triage runbook (escalation matrix, handoff checklist, expected SLAs for unblock actions).
- Dashboard wireframe and initial Console slice request for Observability team.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring formula documented and ratified by Eng/Design/Security/Infra leads
Dependency costing matrix populated for at least 30 initiative-level dependencies
One-page charter template published in Confluence and linked from roadmaps
Runbook published with clear escalation steps and on-call contact points
Pilot workshop held with signoffs from two engineering and one design lead
Dashboard wireframe submitted (Console ticket) and data contract defined
